rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); SkiaCanvas text looks its laid-out SkParagraph up in a process-wide LRU (pulp/canvas/paragraph_cache.hpp) keyed by the text, resolved family stack, primary typeface, size, weight, slant, letter spacing, direction, OpenType features and font-registration generation, bounded by entry count and an estimated byte footprint. Cached paragraphs carry no foreground paint and draw through a ParagraphPainter that applies the caller's paint, so colour, gradient, stroke and filter changes reuse one entry; each entry is used under its own lock. Cached renders are byte-identical to uncached ones on raster and Graphite; no public API is removed and no design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
